prose: A generative-AI scandal has reached one of Nikon's photography competitions - the latest contest to discover AI-generated or AI-manipulated entries among its submissions or winners. Photo contests keep learning the same lesson: detection-after-the-fact is a poor substitute for entry rules designed for the generative era.
highlights: Generative AI scandal hits a Nikon photography competition
Another contest caught retrofitting rules to the generative era
